overviewPrompt: Create a polished high fidelity UI concept board for an Android app called ControleGitHub inspired by Samsung One UI design principles (not Samsung branded). A wide landscape board showing SIX equally sized portrait mobile screen designs in a clean 3 by 2 grid, every screen fully visible with generous margins, no perspective, no phones or photography. Exact screen names in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Boas-vindas', 'Início', 'Repositórios', 'Detalhe', 'Trabalho', 'Notificações'. Style: premium native Android One UI, black background #080808, dark gray grouped list surfaces #1C1C1E, smooth large 28px rounded cards, large bold humanist sans headers in a spacious upper viewing area, lower thumb reachable interaction area, cobalt blue #3E85FF accent, white text, muted gray secondary text, green open issue dots and purple pull request badges. Clean outlined icons, generous touch targets, consistent four-item bottom navigation 'Início', 'Repos', 'Trabalho', 'Avisos'. Welcome: simple blue code branch emblem, large text 'Seu GitHub, sob controle.', explanatory subtitle and large blue pill 'Continuar com GitHub' plus secondary 'Explorar demonstração'. Home: greeting 'Olá, playertwo1', large 'Visão geral', compact counters 3 repos, 13 issues, 2 PRs, attention list and recent repository. Repositories: large heading, native rounded search field 'Buscar repositório', chips 'Todos', 'Públicos', 'Privados', grouped rows 'controlegithub', 'ideias_standard', 'orbit-design', language badges Kotlin/Python/TypeScript. Detail: heading 'controlegithub', owner playertwo1, stats, pill tabs 'Resumo', 'Issues', 'PRs', latest activity. Work: heading 'Seu trabalho', segmented selector 'Issues'/'Pull requests', rounded list rows with concise plausible Portuguese tasks and labels. Notifications: heading 'Notificações', unread/read tabs, grouped mentions and review requests. Small 'Dados de exemplo' indicator on all signed-in screens. Legible restrained text, realistic information density, no neon, no glassmorphism, no giant gradients, no watermarks. This is a design reference board, not implemented screenshots. Add a small board title outside screen designs 'ControleGitHub · Referência One UI · Conceito v1'.
